findings.statement: Six contrast coefficients improve an unchanged radio map but remain slightly weaker than the flexible comparator.
findings.applicability: Complete dates retain furniture variants; known positions and 3120 initial calibration-cell means are declared access.
findings.limitations: Only 1/3 dates beat flexible. Correction has six coefficients plus a 3120-cell measured map; temporal transfer at calibrated positions is not localization or unseen-position transfer.
falsification: Distinguish RSSI dBm measurements from dB errors and preserve actual calendar dates.
Disallow target-date offsets or recalibration; baseline coverage must include both furniture states when available.
Keep date-level uncertainty and report missing furniture day 86 rather than inventing it.
